title: Private Downtown Detroit Helicopter Ride
blurb: The Detroit Ambassador Bridge ride is our most popular helicopter experience, spanning 20 miles of Detroit’s mesmerizing landscape. More than just a ride, it’s a full immersion into the heart and soul of the Motor City. The adventure unfolds as you are lifted into the air to begin your journey, heading towards the heart of Detroit where a panorama of the city’s splendors unfold beneath you.
